prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.5% overall).
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
Path selection redesigns, adoption redesigns, and new adoption flows showed no clear effect across tests.
Evidence remains thin for home flows (home, new_flow) with only 1 test completed.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -0.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.5% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Grid Selection Layout: Redesign the choose_path screen into a structured grid layout displaying companion archetypes side-by-side with trait summaries. (why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with a mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion or decision inertia among users.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Adoption Customization Flow: Introduce an interactive companion selection flow featuring real-time trait previews before completing adoption. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9%, and support mails report custom pet generation errors and visual mismatches.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Upload Photos Split Guidance Layout: Redesign the photo upload screen into a split view showing live image previews next to clear framing instructions. (why: Support receives tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong due to poor photo inputs during generation.)
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Display Status Screen: Insert a desktop display validation screen right after waiting to verify display permissions and confirm rendering. (why: Three support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling when opening the home view.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Multi Device Sync Account Hint: Display reassurance text on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in restores and syncs existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or being reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Companion Render Progress Tips: Show an animated tip carousel and estimated time remaining during the companion rendering waiting stage. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, causing drop-offs while companion assets compile.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Interaction Controls Guide Copy: Update the home intro text with explicit instructions on how to access, control, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails ask how to control or hide pets after completing onboarding, while finish conversion is 64.8%.)
7: [home, notification] Background Generation Ready Notification: Enable desktop notification opt-ins on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet is ready to view. (why: High average wait time (2336s) leads to users abandoning the app while pet assets build in the background.)
